newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Faber awards United Engineer job.
newsitem.headline: Faber awards United Engineer job.

text.p: United Engineers Ltd said on Tuesday Faber Group Bhd had been awarded its subsidiary, United MHL (M) Sdn Bhd, a hospital support service contract worth over 100 million ringgit over five years.
United Engineers said in a statement the contract was awarded by Faber's subsidiary, Faber MediServe Sdn Bhd (FMS).
The contract involves the provision of technical services in facility engineering, linen and laundary operations and housekeeping to nine Malaysian Ministry of Health hospitals.
The contract is for five years starting January 1 1997.
FMS was among the three firms earlier awarded contracts by the Malaysian government to provide nationwide hospital support services for 15 years.
